conditional_flow_ratios.assumptions: Comparable free-air conditions, quoted delivery maintained, compressor duty permits replenishment, zero losses. Not a commissioning or duty rating.

illustrative_capacity_not_hardware_predi.note: Illustrates mass-flow leverage only. Larger cold throughput requires a matched converter/bank and measured cold delivery. A single existing vortex cannot consume the whole larger compressor output. No -50 C result is established.

recommendation: Prefer a verified low-pressure continuous dry-air supply for existing vortex/nozzle tests and repeated demos. Rent or borrow an appropriately sized supply before purchase where practical. Consider BAUER for a separately validated cylinder-charging/expander experiment, not as a continuous replacement supply for the current nominal 200-227 L/min vortex.
